arabic text: Do bar namaz shaheed hui, ik Masjid mein ik maktal mein,
english translation text: Twice was prayer itself martyred: once in the mosque, and once in the battlefield.

arabic text: Quran lahu main tar dekha, ik Kufay mein ik Karbal mein.
english translation text: Twice was the Qur'an seen drenched in blood: once in Kufa, and once in Karbala.

arabic text: Ik bar yateem huwi bibi, ik bar howi mohtaje rida,\nDo bar Nabi ka ghar ujra, ik basti mein ik jangal mein.
english translation text: Twice was a lady orphaned, and twice left in need of a veil;\ntwice was the Prophet's household ruined: once in a town, and once in a wilderness.

arabic text: Ghurbat mein yoon majboor kiya be aas Batool ki baiti ko,\nDo bar Madina yaad aaya, Ik zinda mein ik mehmal mein.
english translation text: In exile, the daughter of Batul was left helpless and without hope;\ntwice she remembered Madina: once in the prison, and once in the camel-litter.

arabic text:
Huway zakhmi kaan Masuma kay, pamal Hussain ki laash
hoi,
Do bar qiyamat tout pari, Ik khaimoon mein ik maktal
mein.
english translation text:
Twice did Judgement Day descend: the
innocent child's ears were wounded, and
Hussain's body was trampled; once in
the tents, and once in the battlefield.

arabic text: Kuch paak namazi katal huey, teer o talwaroon say Muhsin,\nKuch zindanoon mein dafan huey, pardesi qaid musalsal\nmein
english translation text: Some pure worshippers were killed by arrows\nand swords, O Mohsin; others were buried\nin prisons, captives in a foreign land.
